tools.name: slottable_list_contacts
tools.description: List the company's contacts (name, email, phone, address, subscription flag). Slottable API: GET /api/v1/companies/{company_id}/contacts.

tools.name: slottable_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id. Slottable API: GET /api/v1/companies/{company_id}/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: slottable_list_slot_types
tools.description: List the company's slot types (bookable services or events: name, duration, price, payment and cancellation rules). Good first call. Slottable API: GET /api/v1/companies/{company_id}/slot-types.

tools.name: slottable_get_slot_type
tools.description: Get one slot type by id, including its default duration, price and booking rules. Slottable API: GET /api/v1/companies/{company_id}/slot-types/{id}.

tools.name: slottable_list_slot_type_instances
tools.description: List the dated slots (instances) of one slot type: datetime, duration, total slots, price and publish state. Slottable API: GET /api/v1/companies/{company_id}/slot-types/{slot_type_id}/slot-type-instances.

tools.name: slottable_get_slot_type_instance
tools.description: Get one dated slot (instance) of a slot type. Slottable API: GET /api/v1/companies/{company_id}/slot-types/{slot_type_id}/slot-type-instances/{id}.

tools.name: slottable_list_slot_type_instance_roster
tools.description: List the contacts on the roster of one dated slot (who is registered for it). Slottable API: GET /api/v1/companies/{company_id}/slot-types/{slot_type_id}/slot-type-instances/{slot_type_instance_id}/contacts.

tools.name: slottable_list_slot_type_instance_bookings
tools.description: List the bookings made for one dated slot (booking id, token, cancellation time). For who is on the slot, use slottable_list_slot_type_instance_roster. Slottable API: GET /api/v1/companies/{company_id}/slot-types/{slot_type_id}/slot-type-instances/{slot_type_instance_id}/bookings.

tools.name: slottable_list_latest_booking_contacts
tools.description: List the most recent booking contacts across the company's slots, with their contact details. Slottable API: GET /api/v1/companies/{company_id}/latest-booking-contacts.

tools.name: slottable_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the company's webhook subscriptions (target URL, model, events, filter). Slottable API: GET /api/v1/companies/{company_id}/webhooks.

tools.name: slottable_get_webhook
tools.description: Get one webhook subscription by id. Slottable API: GET /api/v1/companies/{company_id}/webhooks/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: slottable_list_contacts, slottable_list_webhooks · Private data: slottable_list_contacts, slottable_get_contact, slottable_list_slot_type_instance_roster, slottable_list_slot_type_instance_bookings, slottable_list_latest_booking_contacts · Public sink: slottable_list_contacts, slottable_list_slot_type_instances, slottable_list_webhooks, slottable_get_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: slottable_list_contacts, slottable_list_webhooks · Private data: slottable_list_contacts, slottable_get_contact, slottable_list_slot_type_instance_roster, slottable_list_slot_type_instance_bookings, slottable_list_latest_booking_contacts · Public sink: slottable_list_contacts, slottable_list_slot_type_instances, slottable_list_webhooks, slottable_get_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
